dialogue.intro: Prepare ranged equipment before your next fight. Keep spare arrows within reach.
dialogue.progress: Check your equipment and ammunition before setting out.
dialogue.complete: Your ranged kit is ready for the next expedition.

dialogue.intro: Bamboo can be useful even when there is no forest nearby. Keep some when you find it.
dialogue.progress: Look along rivers and through jungle biomes.
dialogue.complete: Plant a little near home for a renewable supply.

dialogue.intro: Prepare a compound bow for your next expedition.
dialogue.progress: Check the recipe and gather the materials you need.
dialogue.complete: Take it somewhere you have room to aim.
